title: Recognition of Eminent Citizens
summary: Annual awards honouring eminent citizens of society, presented with a cash prize, citation and memento at a formal convocation.

title: Honouring Cultural Contributors
summary: Felicitation of accomplished individuals on the occasion of Sree Ramanavami through the Prathibha Puraskaram.

title: Publications
summary: Publication of Guruji's writings on ancient history, philosophy and cultural commentary, and support for other authors working in the same field.

title: Media & Preservation
summary: Television and film work portraying the history and culture of Andhra — including a feature on the Buddha that received a special jury award.

title: Promotion of the Performing Arts
summary: Sponsoring music academies, conducting annual festivals, establishing free music learning centres, and conferring titles such as Sangeetha Vidya Nidhi.

title: Heritage Exhibition
summary: Cultural exhibitions of charts and artefacts covering the region's history from prehistoric times to the modern day.

title: Medical Outreach
summary: Medical camps in tribal areas across several Indian states, providing free medicines and other necessities.
